parts: Dec. 11, 2025: the rear lifting jacks failed during this move. The rear support fell onto the guideway, and the Clayton Clipper was out of service for two months.

I wasn’t watching as closely back then, but I think the rear lifting jacks weren’t used again until span 32. Until then, a modified move with a ballast segment took their place. It isn’t shown in this animation.
Span 29 crosses the future 72 Ave intersection. It has 16 segments, more than the 12 the gantry can hang, so crews built it on a temporary support tower. The animation simplifies this.
Span 50 will have 15 or 16 segments, more than the 12 the gantry can hang, so it will rest on a temporary support tower while they’re hung. The animation simplifies this.
